proposal.reason: The substantive changes are to open-source test workflow orchestration: dual-platform (M890P/OAM-810E) job matrices, case generation/grouping/reconciliation, CI runtime environment injection, optional HPN SDK installation, and performance/reporting metadata in GitHub Actions and xtest tooling.
